adequacy_evidence.quote: This supports the reported *absence of corrected evidence*, not a claim that vmPFC has no gain response. Limitations are material but disclosed: sign-flip inference assumes symmetry/exchangeability; the broad coordinate box is not a cytoarchitectonic definition; there are no participant variance maps, so unequal first-level uncertainty is not modeled; and the reported gain coefficients are not per-currency-unit effects. The supplied maps and upstream-methods description support the stated group-stage scope. The result does not estimate a gain-versus-loss contrast.

hypothesis_conclusion.quote: No whole-brain-corrected evidence supported the predicted vmPFC increase.
